title: Final Project: Build a Responsive Website
description: Test your knowledge on building a complete responsive website using CSS concepts covered throughout the course.

quiz.question: What CSS property is commonly used to make a website responsive?
quiz.explanation: Media queries allow CSS to adapt the layout based on screen size.

quiz.question: Which unit is preferred for responsive font sizes?
quiz.explanation: rem units scale relative to the root font size, improving accessibility.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the viewport meta tag in responsive design?
options: To control the page’s width and scaling on different devices
quiz.correctAnswer: To control the page’s width and scaling on different devices
quiz.explanation: It ensures the page scales correctly on mobile devices.

quiz.question: Which CSS layout technique is most suitable for one-dimensional layouts?
quiz.explanation: Flexbox is ideal for laying out items in a single row or column.

quiz.question: What does the CSS property 'max-width: 100%' achieve in responsive images?
options: Prevents image from exceeding its container width
quiz.correctAnswer: Prevents image from exceeding its container width
quiz.explanation: This ensures images shrink to fit smaller containers.

quiz.question: How can you test your responsive website on different devices?
options: Using browser developer tools device simulation
By changing the monitor resolution physically
quiz.correctAnswer: Using browser developer tools device simulation
quiz.explanation: Most browsers offer device emulation for responsive testing.

quiz.question: Why is mobile-first design recommended?
options: Because mobile devices are simpler to design for
It ensures the website is optimized for smaller screens first
quiz.correctAnswer: It ensures the website is optimized for smaller screens first
quiz.explanation: Mobile-first makes sure basic functionality loads on small devices, then scales up.

quiz.question: What is the advantage of using CSS variables in large projects?
options: They reduce repetition and simplify theme changes
quiz.correctAnswer: They reduce repetition and simplify theme changes
quiz.explanation: CSS variables allow easy updates to colors, fonts, and other properties globally.

quiz.question: What role does 'flex-wrap' play in a Flexbox layout?
options: Determines if flex items wrap onto multiple lines
Defines the direction of flex items
quiz.correctAnswer: Determines if flex items wrap onto multiple lines
quiz.explanation: 'flex-wrap' allows items to wrap when they don’t fit in one line.

quiz.question: Which CSS property can be used to create smooth animations during transitions?
quiz.explanation: The 'transition' property enables smooth change between property states.
